title: Noam Chomsky Stumps Andrew Marr
summary: A three-minute clip of Noam Chomsky in an exchange with BBC journalist Andrew Marr about media filtering and self-censorship. Chomsky argues that people reach positions precisely because they would not say things that conflict with the system.
why: Cited as the source of Chomsky's 'you wouldn't be sitting where you're sitting' line in threads on media bias and corporate employees defending their employers.

quote.text: I'm not saying you're self-censoring; I'm sure you believe everything you're saying.
